correctness.rationale: A complete local Fourier proof with explicit moment coefficients and strict odd-frequency bound establishes the infinite one-cell inequality and equality classification. Scaling and continuity prove the arbitrary-partition formula. Orthogonal Pythagoras and an exactly orthogonal cosine attain the full-norm uniform upper bound, matched by the free-Neumann 2N width. The only numerical diagnostics are explicitly supplementary.
